facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute's Electronic Government Division installed Starlink satellite internet kits in Moomba Chiefdom, Kazungula District, as part of the government's efforts to bring internet connectivity to rural communities.
facts.system: Smart Zambia Institute Starlink rollout in Moomba Chiefdom

facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute's rollout connected three rural community institutions in Moomba Chiefdom: Moomba Rural Health Clinic, Choonzo Primary School and Kalamba Primary School.
